subject: Senior Leaders: Offer Clearance Playbook & Q4 Commitments
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Senior Leaders: Offer Clearance Playbook & Q4 Commitments

Team —

Following our staffing review, the attached playbook (exec-offer-playbook-v2.xlsx) and the Q4 commitments PDF summarize the ask: clearance to extend offers for three senior roles in Q4 and to approve the compensation bands for each role so recruiters can present target offers. High level:

- VP, Infrastructure — comp band target: $320k–$380k total comp (base + target equity/bonus).
- Head of Research Ops — comp band target: $225k–$270k.
- Director, Model Platform — comp band target: $200k–$235k.

Asks: 1) Please confirm band ceilings and whether we have authority to sign offers up to band cap (vs. needing CFO/CEO co-sign). 2) Approve release of the three headcount slots from the hiring budget for Q4.

Notes: NorthPoint and Greenleaf have active pipelines; we have verbal candidate acceptances pending final offer details. Marcus — can you confirm the run-rate impact to our monthly OPEX if all three accept? Laura — can you confirm comp bands for VP role align with executive corridor we discussed? Vivek — I need an approval path from you for who signs (auto-approve up to X, escalate above). I’m attaching a redline of our offer matrix and a draft HC-release we’d use for Finance.

Attachments: [Attachment: exec-offer-playbook-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)], [Attachment: q4-senior-hc-commitments.pdf (pdf, 68KB)]

Thanks — trying to close this loop by EOD next Friday 11/10 so recruiters can lock compensation and send offers the week after.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Talent Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Leaders: Offer Clearance Playbook & Q4 Commitments

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear summary and the playbook. Quick responses inline:

- VP, Infrastructure band (320–380k): the top-of-band looks reasonable given market comps, but we should lock a policy: any offer CTC above $360k requires CFO notification; above $380k requires CEO sign-off.
- Headcount release: I’m +1 on releasing the three slots from our hiring deck, contingent on final OPEX sign-off from Marcus (see below).

Marcus — can you run a fast P&L delta for the FY29 monthly run-rate (include payroll taxes and onboarding ramp) and confirm whether we stay within our FY29 hiring envelope once these hires are included? If there’s any material deficit we need to re-prioritize.

Also: please add a short note in the offer playbook that we will use a maximum of 5% discretionary sign-on for VP level and above (unless approved separately).

On the approval path: Karthik, if we can agree that Vivek can pre-authorize up to the band ceiling with notification to Finance, that will speed recruiters a lot. Anything above ceiling — we route to CEO as per existing policy.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
COO | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Leaders: Offer Clearance Playbook & Q4 Commitments

Karthik / Laura —

Quick finance take after a brief run: if all three offers are accepted at midpoint of band, the incremental monthly payroll + benefits delta is ~ $128k/month (run-rate starting month 3 after hire). If offers land at top-of-band the delta is ~ $156k/month.

Implications:
- FY29 hiring envelope: we remain inside the overall envelope with these hires if we defer two individual IC senior hires currently queued in Q1 to H2. I can provide a detailed schedule if you want to formalize which positions we deprioritize.
- Sign-on: the 5% discretionary cap for sign-ons is fine; anything above 5% needs a finance exception (formal request).

Recommendation: authorize release of the three HC slots and allow pre-authority to sign up to band ceilings with immediate Finance notification. If any offer is proposed above ceiling we get a 24-hour expedited route to CEO for decision.

Attachments: [Attachment: signed-hc-release-draft.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP Finance | Redwood Inference

On Tue, 7 Nov 2028 at 10:08, Laura Bennett wrote:

From: Ellen Shepard <ellen.shepard@greenleafpartners.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, NorthPoint Recruiting <northpoint@recruiting.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Leaders: Offer Clearance Playbook & Q4 Commitments

Hi Karthik / Team —

Greenleaf has progressed the VP, Infrastructure and Director, Model Platform candidates to verbal accept stage pending written offers. A few datapoints from candidates:

- VP candidate (Seattle-based): expects a base in the $270k–290k range; total comp expectation aligns with $340k–360k when factoring equity and bonus. Will accept quickly if we meet midpoint-to-ceiling.
- Director, Model Platform (remote candidate): expects base around $165k–175k; total comp nearer to $210k with equity.

Request: please confirm the maximum total cash (base + sign-on) we’re willing to put in the offer package for these two, so I can instruct candidates to hold and not accept competing timelines. If we can get the playbook version locked today, we’ll dispatch offers tomorrow EOD and give candidates 72 hours to respond.

Thanks — we are seeing a second viable VP candidate but windows are tight.

—Ellen Shepard
Principal, Greenleaf Partners

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Senior Leaders: Offer Clearance Playbook & Q4 Commitments

Thanks all — and thanks Karthik for pulling the playbook together. My decisions:

1) Authorization: Finance and I will pre-authorize offers up to the published band ceilings as long as Marcus’ run-rate confirms no material FY29 gap. Per Marcus’ note, I’m comfortable with pre-authority up to band ceilings (VP up to $380k total comp; Head ROps up to $270k; Director MP up to $235k).
2) Escalation: any ask above band ceilings requires explicit CEO sign-off. We will use a 24-hour expedited window for any above-band ask.
3) HC Release: I sign the draft HC-release (attached) contingent on Marcus finalizing the run-rate memo; please attach the final memo to the HR folder and route the DocuSign link to me for e-signature.

Ellen / NorthPoint — you have clearance to extend offers tomorrow subject to the above ceilings. Please include a 72-hour response window and standard probationary language. Keep the sign-on at or below 5% unless you get separate written exception.

Attachments: [Attachment: signed-hc-release-draft.pdf (pdf, 12KB)]

—Vivek Kulkarni
CEO | Redwood Inference
